subject: Matrix Rain
author: ZombieTron
body:
The rain was proper heavy Matrix style here last week, there was flooding in Whitstable!

Norway has restrictions on the amount of ads they show in TV shows, sometimes on American shows its really obvious where there would be an ad in the states (and here) but the ads have been cut for Norway. It means 24 is more like 21 and a half!
